slot.brief: Hydrolysis products of covalent halides (e.g. PCl5, NCl3, SiCl4) — complete/balance the reaction and pick the correct product set including HCl formation or disproportionation.

stem: The products formed when $\text{PCl}_5$ undergoes complete hydrolysis in excess water are:

verdicts.working: Complete hydrolysis: PCl₅ + 4H₂O → H₃PO₄ + 5HCl. The products match option A.

working:
$\text{PCl}_5+4\text{H}_2\text{O}\rightarrow\text{H}_3\text{PO}_4+5\text{HCl}$

Independent check: Complete hydrolysis: PCl₅ + 4H₂O → H₃PO₄ + 5HCl. The products match option A.
solution:
Complete hydrolysis of $\text{PCl}_5$ produces phosphoric acid and hydrogen chloride:
$$\text{PCl}_5+4\text{H}_2\text{O}\rightarrow\text{H}_3\text{PO}_4+5\text{HCl}$$
Thus, the products are $\text{H}_3\text{PO}_4$ and $\text{HCl}$.
